name: IKON SKILLS™
tagline: One FREE Micro-Credential for every new Practitioner, no card needed
description: One FREE Micro-Credential for every new Practitioner, no card needed. IKON SKILLS™ is a 100% AI-native, competency-based platform for verifying practical skills: each Micro-Credential requires at least 75% mastery across 10 Core Competencies, worked through AI Interaction Points (AIPs). Credentials sit in a verifiable IKON SKILLS™ Passport employers can check through one link, and stack toward Emerging Degrees from European International University (EIU-Paris). Freemium, paid from USD 14.99 per Micro-Credential.
makerName: Ky. Col. Prof. Dr. Edward Roy Krishnan
